integrity: The proof uses the standard Lanczos polynomial exactness identity, strict Rayleigh-Ritz endpoint separation, and an explicit affine interpolation sign calculation. The exact witness is independently replayed with rational spectral moments. A March 2004 preprint is bibliographically reported without an exact day; the date field therefore records the earliest exact-day public presentation verified for that work, 2004-06-02, without inventing a day.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a complete exact-arithmetic classification for the two-step symmetric Lanczos approximation on diagonal positive definite systems with strictly positive starting vector. Higher Krylov dimensions, finite-precision loss of orthogonality, restarted methods, nonsymmetric Arnoldi, and general non-diagonal positive semigroups are not classified.
source_ids: Sparse Days 2004 presentation: Preconditioning Lanczos approximations to the matrix exponential, 2004-06-02
title: The exact positivity horizon of the two-step Lanczos exponential
